title: The tic-tac as an unrepeatable anomaly that challenges Bacon's scientific method

tellings.quote: however that day something happened that was not repeatable the existence of the tic tac so somewhere in that air was this anomaly this thing that does not and is not repeatable yet it was clearly something that needs to be studied

plain: The Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint that Navy pilots reported seeing, is offered as proof that science built on repeatable experiments, the method laid out by Francis Bacon, cannot handle one-off events that still demand study. The researcher Deep Prasad makes this argument on the show, saying that on that day 'something happened that was not repeatable' and yet 'was clearly something that needs to be studied', and he draws on a work titled The Evolution of Science and the Interactive Universe. If he is right, the usual scientific method would need to change to study such encounters.
